title: Training Note: Volume Reduction on Residential Electricity Supply Plan Changes
content:
Training note, Residential Electricity Supply plan changes.

**Q. How is the plan volume reduction decided?**
A. The kWh of all of the agreement's energy charge lines are divided by its billing cycles that carry an on-peak or an all-hours energy line; at 1,200 kWh per cycle or more the high plan volume reduction of 0.20 cents per kWh applies, from 800 up to but not including 1,200 kWh the mid plan volume reduction of 0.10 cents per kWh applies, and below 800 kWh none applies.

**Q. Which kWh and which cycles?**
A. The kWh on every energy charge line of the agreement, whenever billed, all-hours, on-peak and off-peak alike; the cycles are the agreement's billing cycles that carry an on-peak or an all-hours energy line. An agreement with no such cycles has none.

| kWh per billed cycle | Plan volume reduction (cents per kWh) |
|---|---|
| 1,200 or more | 0.20 |
| 800 up to but not including 1,200 | 0.10 |
| below 800 | none |

**Q. A hypothetical case?**
A. Ten flat-rate cycles totalling 11,950 kWh are 1,195 kWh per cycle, 0.10 cents; at 12,000 kWh they are 1,200 kWh per cycle, 0.20 cents.
